risks.note: A significant portion of revenue is derived from international markets - exports contributed 99% of total turnover - exposing the Company to currency fluctuations, particularly USD/INR, which may impact profitability and cash flows; mitigated through a calibrated hedging strategy that maintains prudent hedge coverage on net foreign currency exposure while retaining flexibility to benefit from favourable moves.
risks.risk: Foreign exchange risk from export concentration

risks.note: Rapid adoption of AI and digital technologies has intensified competition for specialised talent, and the ability to attract, develop and retain skilled professionals is critical to sustaining innovation and execution; permanent-employee turnover was 22% in FY26 (24% FY25, 33% FY24). Mitigation includes building an AI-native workforce through targeted capability development, GenAI-enabled engineering practices, Code Shield workshops and adoption of GitHub Copilot.
risks.risk: Talent and capability risk in an AI-scarce labour market

risks.note: Increasing cyber threats, evolving data privacy regulations and rising expectations on responsible AI usage elevate compliance and security requirements; failure to address them could impact customer trust, reputation and business performance. BRSR identifies Data Privacy and Security as a material risk, given regulatory penalties, legal liabilities, operational disruption and reputational damage from non-compliance or cyber incidents.

Rapid advances in AI platforms and managed agent ecosystems may alter customer preferences, while established global players, niche providers, hyperscalers and emerging AI-native companies compete for the same customers; intensifying competition may affect new-customer acquisition, retention, pricing and market share. Mitigation is continuous benchmarking plus a balanced mix of proprietary innovation and selected third-party AI capabilities.
risks.risk: Technology disruption and competitive intensity / market positioning

risks.note: Growing demand for GenAI solutions increases dependence on specialised computing infrastructure including GPUs; supply constraints and extended procurement lead times may affect product development and customer deployments. Mitigated by optimising solution architectures, using a mix of on-premise and cloud infrastructure, and deploying open-source AI models for selected use cases.

Delays in customer-side infrastructure readiness and extended hardware procurement cycles may affect implementation timelines; addressed via cloud-based deployment alternatives, embedding infrastructure-readiness requirements in project planning, and working with approved vendor ecosystems.
risks.risk: Project execution and supply chain dependency on customer readiness

risks.note: The telecom industry operates under disciplined capital allocation; during periods of constrained capex, CSPs may defer or reprioritise investments in digital transformation, operational modernisation and business support platforms, directly affecting demand for Subex's software and business assurance platforms. CSPs are expected to remain selective, prioritising spend that delivers measurable improvements.
risks.risk: Customer capital-expenditure discipline and demand deferral

risks.note: Geopolitical tensions, regional conflicts, trade restrictions and evolving regulatory landscapes may delay customer investment decisions, disrupt project execution and create demand volatility across geographies; restrictions on cross-border operations and supply chains may hinder implementation and technology deployment.
